svg.title: Every change has to prove itself
svg.desc: A code change passes format, lint, typecheck, knip, syncpack, test, build, publint, Playwright with axe, and Lighthouse gates before it can merge and deploy. Failing any gate stops the change.

span.p: Every change has to prove itself
A change, mine or an agent's

Fail any gate and the change stops here.
Most run before it ever leaves my laptop.
